qualifier: naive and memory B cell surface markers
name: Naive and memory B cell surface expression signatures
rationale: All members are B cell or lymphocyte transcriptional/surface-marker signature modules; unlike confusables they lack B cell activation, germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation programs.

qualifier: melanin biosynthesis and pigment granule localization
name: MITF melanocyte gene program and melanin pigmentation
rationale: Members are MITF-M-regulated melanocyte gene programs plus melanin synthesis, pigment granule and albinism pathways; the pigmentation arm distinguishes it from MITF/UV-response and melanocyte proliferation confusables.

qualifier: desmosomes, hemidesmosomes, apical-basal polarity and EMT
name: Epithelial adherens, desmosomal junctions, polarity and EMT
rationale: Members cover cadherin adherens junctions, desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, epithelial polarity and EMT, which separates it from cadherin-regulation and tight-junction confusables.

name: Pyrimidine nucleotide catabolism and salvage
rationale: Members are catabolism, salvage and metabolism of pyrimidine (deoxy)nucleotides and nucleobases, distinguishing them from purine deoxynucleotide, nucleoside triphosphate and de novo pyrimidine synthesis confusables.

name: SLC4 bicarbonate and alkanesulfonate anion transport
rationale: Members are SLC4 bicarbonate transporters, their renal tubular acidosis defects and alkanesulfonate transport, unlike SLC26 anion exchange, carbonic anhydrase or enamel mineralization confusables.

name: Hematopoietic stem cell self-renewal and differentiation control
rationale: Members regulate hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell proliferation, homeostasis and differentiation, not erythroid maturation or thymocyte/bone marrow proliferation as in confusables.

name: BAF (SWI/SNF) chromatin remodeling complex assembly
rationale: Most members are formation of BAF complex variants plus CHD1/2 remodelers and stem cell maintenance, distinct from histone acetylation and nucleosome assembly confusables.

qualifier: cellular processing and methylmalonic acidemia defects
name: Cellular cobalamin processing and methylmalonic acidemia defects
rationale: Members are cobalamin transport to and processing within cells, propionyl-CoA catabolism and inherited cbl/MUT defects, unlike confusables centred on intestinal dietary cobalamin uptake and other vitamins.

qualifier: heterochromatin foci, PML bodies and secretory phenotype
name: Cellular senescence with heterochromatin foci and secretory phenotype
rationale: Members are senescence induction and its regulation, including SAHF/subtelomeric heterochromatin, PML bodies, Polycomb silencing and SASP, whereas confusables centre on p16/p14ARF/TP53 defects, UV response or apoptosis.

qualifier: TAK1 complex activation via TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF
name: TLR-induced TAK1 complex activation via TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF
rationale: Members are TLR adaptor steps activating the TAK1 (and IKK) complex through TRAF6, IRAK2 and TRIF, unlike confusables on TLR regulation, TRIF-mediated cell death or IRAK1-IKK recruitment.

name: Lipid droplet formation and intracellular triglyceride homeostasis
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation/fusion and triglyceride and fatty acid homeostasis, unlike confusables on lipophagy, droplet disassembly, glycerolipid synthesis enzymes or LXR control.

name: Cornified envelope assembly and epidermal barrier formation
rationale: Members are cornification, cornified envelope cross-linking and skin barrier establishment, distinct from keratinocyte differentiation control, desmosome and lipoxygenase confusables.

qualifier: constitutive signaling by EGFR and ERBB2 mutants
name: Constitutive signaling by oncogenic EGFR and ERBB2 mutants
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-mutant EGFR or ERBB2, unlike confusables on ERBB2 drug resistance/inhibition or FGFR alterations.

name: AID/APOBEC cytidine deamination in antibody diversification and antiviral defense
rationale: Members span C-to-U deamination/editing used in somatic hypermutation, class switching and B cell development and APOBEC3G antiviral restriction, unlike ADAR A-to-I editing and HIV life-cycle confusables.

name: Histamine, prostanoid and leukotriene G protein-coupled receptors
rationale: Members are GPCR modules and receptor signaling for histamine, prostanoids and leukotrienes; histamine receptors and metabolism distinguish it from eicosanoid-synthesis and endocannabinoid confusables.

name: Mucosal antibacterial defense by non-defensin antimicrobial proteins
rationale: Members concern host killing, agglutination, metal sequestration and mucosal defense against bacteria, whereas confusables are defined by defensins, antifungal and nematode responses.

qualifier: folate, cobalamin and methionine cycle with inherited defects
name: Folate, cobalamin and methionine one-carbon metabolism and inherited defects
rationale: Members cover folate/pterin metabolism, cobalamin uptake and processing, methionine/SAM salvage and their inherited enzyme defects, unlike choline/carnitine or B1/B2/biotin vitamin confusables.

qualifier: retinoic acid and vitamin D with CYP enzyme defects
name: Retinoic acid and calcitriol metabolism with CYP enzyme defects
rationale: Members are retinoic acid and vitamin D3 activation/inactivation and response, including CYP26/CYP27B1/CYP24A1 defects, unlike retinol/retinal, vitamin K or steroidogenic CYP confusables.

qualifier: SRP and tail-anchored targeting, insertion and retention
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP-dependent and tail-anchored protein targeting and insertion into the ER, folding, ER retention/exit and ERQC, unlike COPII export and ERAD confusables.

name: Androgen receptor signaling and RUNX2 osteoblast differentiation
rationale: Members are androgen/testosterone and AR signaling plus RUNX2 regulation of osteoblasts and bone, the RUNX2/bone arm distinguishing it from estrogen-receptor confusables.

name: Dopamine receptor signaling via adenylyl cyclase and beta-arrestin
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor signaling (cAMP-coupled and beta-arrestin) and its locomotor output, unlike confusables on dopaminergic transmission, drug responses, PLC-coupled signaling or dopamine synthesis/transport.

qualifier: heme A and erythroid heme metabolism
name: Heme biosynthesis including heme A and erythroid heme metabolism
rationale: Members are heme biosynthesis modules, heme A synthesis and the erythroid heme metabolism signature, distinct from heme B/porphyrin, iron-sulfur and HMOX1/iron-response confusables.

name: RNA pseudouridylation and mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification
rationale: Members are pseudouridine synthesis in tRNA, rRNA and mRNA plus mitochondrial tRNA processing/modification, unlike tRNA aminoacylation, methylation or mitoribosome assembly confusables.

name: Receptor-mediated viral attachment, entry and cell-cell fusion
rationale: Members are virion receptor binding, receptor-mediated endocytic entry and virus-induced cell-cell fusion, unlike virus-specific entry, protein maturation and life-cycle regulation confusables.

qualifier: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC function
name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RNA-induced silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing, RISC assembly, miRNA turnover and miRNA-directed translational repression and deadenylation, unlike lncRNA/ceRNA, RNA-binding-protein decay or decapping confusables.
